This document takes as input the wrangled data for all available combinations of biological assay and compound. First we define subsets for each assay-compound combination based on experimental design. Then datasets of the same biological design are merged and subsequently used for BMD analysis using the process_subset code. BMD analysis is performed using a BMR of 50% increase relative to background as well as a BMR of 1 SD elevation relative to background. The plots generated in this script were used as the basis for Figure 4 and Figure S4 presented in: 'Advancing AOPs for genotoxicity through quantifying KERs linking DNA alkylation to increase in mutations and chromosome aberrations' by Winkelman et al., 2026.

Loading packages
```{r,warning=F, message=F}
library(minpack.lm)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
source('Functions_BMD.R')
```

Reading in the data
```{r}
EMSdata = readRDS('../processedData/EMSdata.rds')
MMSdata = readRDS('../processedData/MMSdata.rds')
ENUdata = readRDS('../processedData/ENUdata.rds')
```

Some final data wrangling to optimize for BMD analysis
```{r}
#Get rid of CAA for MMS
MMSdata[['CAA']] = NULL

#Initialize missing columns
ENUdata$comet$enzyme_modification = 'Unmodified'
ENUdata$comet$`Relative survival (%)` = NA
ENUdata$MN$S9 = 'no'
ENUdata$gh2ax$S9 = 'no'

#Split comet assay data into FPG and hAAG modified assays
comets = split(EMSdata$cometall, EMSdata$cometall$enzyme_modification)
names(comets) = paste("Comet", names(comets))
EMSdata = c(EMSdata, comets)
EMSdata$cometall = NULL

comets = split(MMSdata$cometall, MMSdata$cometall$enzyme_modification)
names(comets) = paste("Comet", names(comets))
MMSdata = c(MMSdata, comets)
MMSdata$cometall = NULL
```


#BMD50 based approach
```{r, warning=FALSE}
EMS_subsets = lapply(names(EMSdata), function(assay_name) {
  
  df = EMSdata[[assay_name]]
  
  generate_subsets(df, assay_name)
  
})

names(EMS_subsets) = names(EMSdata)

EMS_results = list()
EMS_wpinput = list()
EMS_wps = list()
EMS_names = character()

for (assay_name in names(EMS_subsets)) {
  
  subsets_tbl = EMS_subsets[[assay_name]]
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(subsets_tbl))) {
    
    res = process_subset(
      df = subsets_tbl$data[[i]],
      assay_name = assay_name,
      subset_name = subsets_tbl$subset_name[i],
      conc_col = "Concentration",
      compound = 'EMS'
    )
    
    # Skip invalid subsets
    if (is.null(res)) next
    
    EMS_results[[length(EMS_results) + 1]] = data.frame(
      assay   = assay_name,
      subset  = subsets_tbl$subset_name[i],
      BMD_low = res$bmdres$BMD_low,
      BMD_high= res$bmdres$BMD_high,
      BMD     = res$bmdres$BMD
    )
    

    #EMS_wps[[length(EMS_wps) + 1]] = res$boot_long
    EMS_wpinput[[length(EMS_wpinput) + 1]] = res$wpinput
    
    EMS_names = c(EMS_names, paste(assay_name, subsets_tbl$subset_name[i], sep = "_"))
  }
}

#names(EMS_wps) = EMS_names
names(EMS_wpinput) = EMS_names
```

```{r}
# Combine all three
df = bind_rows(
  convert_results(EMS_results, "EMS"),
  convert_results(MMS_results, "MMS"),
  convert_results(ENU_results, "ENU")
)

# Add KE classification
df = df %>%
  mutate(
    KE = case_when(
      assay == "alkyl" ~ "KE adducts",
      assay == "Comet hAAG modified" ~ "KE adducts",
      assay == "Comet Fpg modified" ~ "KE oxidative stress",
      assay == "Comet Unmodified" ~ "KE strand breaks",
      assay == "gh2ax" ~ "KE strand breaks",
      assay == "MN" ~ "KE chromosome aberrations",
      assay %in% c("muta", "ECDS") ~ "KE heritable mutations",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


df = df %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste(assay, subset, sep = " | "),
    label = str_replace(label, "\\|\\s*$", "")  # remove trailing |
  )

df = df[complete.cases(df),]

df = df %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste(KE, assay, subset, sep = " | ")
  )

# Enforce order in the dataframe

#order based on KE
ke_order = c(
  "KE adducts",
  "KE oxidative stress",
  "KE strand breaks",
  "KE chromosome aberrations",
  "KE heritable mutations"
)

df = df %>%
  mutate(
    KE = factor(KE, levels = ke_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(KE, assay, subset) %>%
 mutate(label = factor(label, levels = unique(label)))

#Order based on assay
df = df %>%
  mutate(
    assay_order = case_when(
      assay == "alkyl" ~ 1,
      assay == "Comet hAAG modified"  ~ 2,
      assay == "Comet Fpg modified" ~ 3,
      assay == "Comet Unmodified" ~ 4,
      assay == "gh2ax" ~ 5,
      assay == "MN" ~ 6,
      assay %in% c("muta", "ECDS") ~ 7,
      TRUE ~ 99
    )
  )

#Order based on subset
df = df %>%
  mutate(
    first_letter = substr(subset, 1, 1),
    second_letter = substr(subset, 2, 2),

    first_order = case_when(
      first_letter == "L" ~ 1,
      first_letter == "S" ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 3
    ),

    second_order = case_when(
      second_letter == "L" ~ 1,
      second_letter == "E" ~ 2,
      second_letter == "I" ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 4
    )
  )

df = df %>%
  arrange(KE, assay_order, first_order, second_order, subset) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = unique(label)))

df50 = df
df50 = df50 %>%
  filter(if_all(c(BMD, BMD_low, BMD_high), is.finite))

write.csv(df50, '../processedData/BMD50ress.csv')
```


```{r}
plot_EMS = plot_BMDresults(filter(df50, compound == "EMS"))
plot_MMS = plot_BMDresults(filter(df50, compound == "MMS"))
plot_ENU = plot_BMDresults(filter(df50, compound == "ENU"))
```

plot_MMS_labeled = plot_BMDresults(filter(df50, compound == "MMS"), y_mode = 'label')
plot_ENU_labeled = plot_BMDresults(filter(df50, compound == "ENU"), y_mode = 'label')

#BMDSD based approach


```{r, warning=FALSE}
EMS_subsets = lapply(names(EMSdata), function(assay_name) {
  
  df = EMSdata[[assay_name]]
  
  generate_subsets(df, assay_name)
  
})

names(EMS_subsets) = names(EMSdata)

EMS_results = list()
EMS_wpinput = list()
EMS_wps = list()
EMS_names = character()

for (assay_name in names(EMS_subsets)) {
  
  subsets_tbl = EMS_subsets[[assay_name]]
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(subsets_tbl))) {
    
    res = process_subset(
      df = subsets_tbl$data[[i]],
      assay_name = assay_name,
      subset_name = subsets_tbl$subset_name[i],
      conc_col = "Concentration",
      compound = 'EMS',
      BMR = 'SD'
    )
    
    # Skip invalid subsets
    if (is.null(res)) next
    
    EMS_results[[length(EMS_results) + 1]] = data.frame(
      assay   = assay_name,
      subset  = subsets_tbl$subset_name[i],
      BMD_low = res$bmdres$BMD_low,
      BMD_high= res$bmdres$BMD_high,
      BMD     = res$bmdres$BMD
    )
    

    #EMS_wps[[length(EMS_wps) + 1]] = res$boot_long
    EMS_wpinput[[length(EMS_wpinput) + 1]] = res$wpinput
    
    EMS_names = c(EMS_names, paste(assay_name, subsets_tbl$subset_name[i], sep = "_"))
  }
}

names(EMS_wpinput) = EMS_names
```

df = bind_rows(

  convert_results(MMS_results, "MMS"),
  convert_results(ENU_results, "ENU")
)

# Add KE classification
df = df %>%
  mutate(
    KE = case_when(
      assay == "alkyl" ~ "KE adducts",
      assay == "Comet hAAG modified" ~ "KE adducts",
      assay == "Comet Fpg modified" ~ "KE oxidative stress",
      assay == "Comet Unmodified" ~ "KE strand breaks",
      assay == "gh2ax" ~ "KE strand breaks",
      assay == "MN" ~ "KE chromosome aberrations",
      assay %in% c("muta", "ECDS") ~ "KE heritable mutations",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


df = df %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste(assay, subset, sep = " | "),
    label = str_replace(label, "\\|\\s*$", "")  # remove trailing |
  )

df = df[complete.cases(df),]

df = df %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste(KE, assay, subset, sep = " | ")
  )

# Enforce order in the dataframe

#order based on KE
ke_order = c(
  "KE adducts",
  "KE oxidative stress",
  "KE strand breaks",
  "KE chromosome aberrations",
  "KE heritable mutations"
)

df = df %>%
  mutate(
    KE = factor(KE, levels = ke_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(KE, assay, subset) %>%
 mutate(label = factor(label, levels = unique(label)))

#Order based on assay
df = df %>%
  mutate(
    assay_order = case_when(
      assay == "alkyl" ~ 1,
      assay %in% c("Comet hAAG modified", "Comet Fpg modified") ~ 2,
      assay == "Comet Unmodified" ~ 3,
      assay == "gh2ax" ~ 4,
      assay == "MN" ~ 5,
      assay %in% c("muta", "ECDS") ~ 6,
      TRUE ~ 99
    )
  )

#Order based on subset
df = df %>%
  mutate(
    first_letter = substr(subset, 1, 1),
    second_letter = substr(subset, 2, 2),

    first_order = case_when(
      first_letter == "L" ~ 1,
      first_letter == "S" ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 3

    second_order = case_when(

      second_letter == "E" ~ 2,

      TRUE ~ 4
    )
  )

df = df %>%

dfSD = df
dfSD = dfSD %>%

write.csv(dfSD, '../processedData/BMDSDress.csv')
